test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL - General Awareness (Held On : 13 Aug 2021 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Mizoram has started ‘Love Brigade’ scheme to fight against which of the following diseases in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__HIV/AIDS__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The '**Love Brigade**' campaign aims to educate people on the **HIV/AIDS** disease.
 
• It was started in Mizoram due to the highest prevalence of HIV/AIDS in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• On World AIDS Day **MSACS (Mizoram State AIDS Control Society)** launched this campaign with a fleet of 500 bikes and taxis.
 
• Collaborating partners: **AIDS Healthcare Foundation (AHF) and Taxi Association, Mizoram**.
 
• "Love condoms" the condoms which will be kept in the back pocket of the front seat with the little flap.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• AHF stated the prevalence rate as** 2.04% **amongst adults which is **10%** higher than the National HIV prevalence that is** 0.22%**.
 
• The new infection rate of the state is** 1.32% which is 20% **higher than** the national average of 0.07%**.
